evals.prompt: Quiero agregar presupuestos mensuales por categoría a la app de mis finanzas. Antes de ponernos a codear, ayúdame a dejar el spec bien definido.
evals.expected_output: Creates docs/specs/<date>-<slug>/requirements.md from the template with numbered EARS acceptance criteria in English, then pauses for approval before design.md.

Acceptance criteria use EARS notation (WHEN / IF / THEN / WHILE / WHERE combined with SHALL)

Contains user stories in the form 'As a <role>, I want <capability>, so that <benefit>'

Respected the approval gate: paused for user approval after requirements before creating design.md
design.md (produced after simulated approval) has architecture, data models, error handling and testing-strategy sections that trace back to requirement numbers

evals.name: category-budgets-scope-boundary
evals.prompt: Quiero spec-ear una feature para mi app de finanzas personales: presupuestos mensuales por categoría. El usuario define un presupuesto mensual (monto) para cada categoría de gasto; el sistema debe alertar cuando el gasto acumulado de una categoría supere el 90% de su presupuesto asignado, y marcar la categoría como 'excedida' si supera el 100%. Para efectos de esta prueba, apruebo de antemano cualquier requirements.md y design.md razonable que generes en base a esta descripción — no te detengas a esperar mi aprobación real, simplemente indica en tu respuesta final en qué punto pedirías esa aprobación, y dime explícitamente qué harías inmediatamente después de que el diseño quede aprobado.
evals.expected_output: Creates requirements.md and design.md only. Explicitly states that tasks.md / the task list is a separate stage owned by the planning-tasks skill, invoked only after design.md is approved — not something this skill drafts itself.
assertions: requirements.md and design.md are created inside a date-stamped docs/specs/ folder
tasks.md is NOT created or hand-drafted by the agent itself
The final response explicitly names 'planning-tasks' (or equivalent /planning-tasks) as the next stage after design approval, not as an internal phase of this same skill
The response does not present the task list as 'Phase 3' of this skill's own scope

evals.name: csv-export-explicit-tasks-request
evals.prompt: Necesito spec-ear una feature de 'exportar reporte de gastos a CSV' para mi app de finanzas. El usuario selecciona un rango de fechas y el sistema genera un CSV descargable con las columnas fecha, categoría, monto y descripción. Quiero que en este mismo intercambio generes TODO: requirements.md, design.md, y también el archivo de tareas (tasks.md), porque quiero empezar a programar ya. Para esta prueba, considera todo pre-aprobado por mí en cada paso — no te detengas a pedir aprobación real, solo indica dónde la pedirías. Sí necesito que me digas explícitamente si vas a generar tú mismo el tasks.md o no, y por qué.
evals.expected_output: Even though the user explicitly asks for tasks.md in the same exchange, the skill declines to draft it directly and explains tasks.md is produced by the planning-tasks skill after design.md is approved.
assertions: requirements.md and design.md are created inside a date-stamped docs/specs/ folder
tasks.md is NOT hand-drafted or embedded in the agent's response despite the explicit user request
The agent explicitly states it will not generate tasks.md itself and names planning-tasks as the skill responsible for it
No task list content (Task overview, Requirements coverage table, T1/T2 entries) appears anywhere in the response

evals.name: real-function-grounding-category-total
evals.prompt: Quiero agregar una funcion calculateCategoryTotal(transactions, category, dateRange) a src/domain/transaction.ts, que sume el 'amount' de las transacciones de tipo 'expense' que caen dentro de una categoria y un rango de fechas dados. Antes de programarla, especificamela: quiero requirements.md y design.md que se basen en el modelo Transaction, Category y CATEGORIES que ya existen en ese archivo (no inventes un sistema de categorias nuevo). Apruebo de antemano requirements.md y design.md razonables.
evals.expected_output: requirements.md and design.md that genuinely ground themselves in the real src/domain/transaction.ts (Transaction interface, Category type, CATEGORIES list, normalizeDate) rather than inventing a parallel model, and no tasks.md.
assertions: design.md explicitly references the REAL existing Transaction interface and/or Category type and/or CATEGORIES from src/domain/transaction.ts (verifiable by reading that file), rather than inventing an incompatible new category/transaction model
The proposed function signature is consistent with the existing Transaction shape (fields: type, amount, currency, date, description, category)
requirements.md and design.md are created; tasks.md is NOT created by the agent itself
The final response explicitly names 'planning-tasks' as the next stage after design approval, not as an internal phase of this same skill
